name: Titan Company Ltd
about: Titan Company Ltd is among India’s most respected lifestyle companies. It has established leadership positions in the Watches, Jewellery and Eyewear categories led by its trusted brands and differentiated customer experience.

items.quote: Should one expect in the near term, at least because of this mix shift or mix change that we are undergoing in the near term, can one expect margin profiles to be tad higher than the 11% mark that we have been doing?
Ashok Sonthalia: I think we still, Mihir, would like to anchor our margin target at around 11%.

Ashok Sonthalia: One thing I will add to Arun's point, and while some of you suggest us that should we relook at our margin guidance, and we keep saying that, no, we want to keep it anchored around 11%, two, three things.

guidance.note: Numeric forward-looking lines found in the latest transcripts. Verdicts need the extraction step (set a model key) or a cached extraction.

bull.text: Revenue has compounded 32.3% a year over 5 years
Profit grew faster than sales (39.1% vs 32.3% a year), so margins widened

bear.text: Growth is slowing: revenue 29.2% a year over 3 years vs 32.3% over 5
Weak cash conversion: operating cash flow only 47% of PAT over 3 years

claims.summary: The prepared remarks on the latest calls had no whole-company figures to check; management spoke in segment numbers.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years only 57% of reported profit came in as operating cash. Reported profit is running well ahead of cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 4 days to pay, against 6 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 13% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. The core business earns most of the profit.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 52% while operating profit grew 47%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 20%, against 26% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: Other income in Sep 2026 was ₹816 cr, 6.6× its recent average and 27% of pre-tax profit. Part of this quarter's profit may not repeat.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 1.51× equity, against 1.79× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 52.9%, unchanged over the last 4 reported quarters.

quality.summary: 6 of 8 checks are clean; look at: profit turns into cash, no one-off boost this quarter.
